files.contextual_review: CI and loop gates both precede artifact publishing. Gate jobs override inherited publish permissions with reads only; publish alone requires contents/OIDC/attestations writes. Tag strings enter env and are validated before outputs; sha and successful-run count are now checked as exact data. Tarball uses the tag reference, SBOM scans exactly that tarball, checksum and attestation bind both artifacts. gh upload uses -- before the tag. No release was published during review.

steps.name: Restrict manual dispatch to main or a tag ref
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
case "${GITHUB_REF}" in
  refs/heads/main|refs/tags/*) echo "dispatch ref ${GITHUB_REF} allowed" ;;
  *)
    echo "workflow_dispatch is restricted to main or a tag ref; got ${GITHUB_REF}" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

steps.name: Verify CI success for the release commit
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="${INPUT_TAG}"
if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"; fi
case "$TAG" in
  *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|'')
    echo "Refusing tag with unexpected characters: ${TAG}" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
REF_JSON="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs/tags/${TAG}")" || {
  echo "Tag refs/tags/${TAG} not found - cannot gate a nonexistent release" >&2
  exit 1
}
SHA="$(printf '%s' "$REF_JSON" | jq -r '.object.sha')"
TYPE="$(printf '%s' "$REF_JSON" | jq -r '.object.type')"
case "$TYPE" in commit|tag) ;; *) echo "Invalid release ref type" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ "$TYPE" = "tag" ]; then
  SHA="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${SHA}" --jq '.object.sha')"
fi
if [[ ! "$SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "Invalid release commit SHA" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Release commit for ${TAG}: ${SHA}"
COUNT="$(gh api \
  "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/test.yml/runs?head_sha=${SHA}&status=success&per_page=1" \
  --jq '.total_count')"
if [[ ! "$COUNT" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo "No successful test.yml run for ${SHA} - release is gated on CI green (design.md:209)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "CI green confirmed for ${SHA} (${COUNT} successful run(s))"

steps.name: Resolve tag
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="$INPUT_TAG"
if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"; fi
case "$TAG" in
  *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|'') echo "Invalid release tag" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "pkg=sdd-forge-${TAG}.tar.gz" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Build reproducible source tarball
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
# Archive the resolved TAG's tree, not $GITHUB_SHA. On a manual
# workflow_dispatch the run's ref (and $GITHUB_SHA) is the dispatch
# branch, which would otherwise package unrelated branch contents
# under the release tag. Fail closed if the tag does not exist.
if ! git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${TAG}" >/dev/null; then
  echo "Tag refs/tags/${TAG} not found in the repository" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# git archive excludes .git and honors .gitattributes export-ignore.
git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="sdd-forge-${TAG}/" -o "$PKG" "refs/tags/${TAG}"
echo "Built $PKG ($(du -h "$PKG" | cut -f1)) from refs/tags/${TAG}"

steps.name: Generate CycloneDX SBOM
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
# Scan exactly the bytes being published, including manual tag dispatches.
snapshot=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-sbom.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$snapshot"' EXIT
tar -xzf "$PKG" -C "$snapshot"
python3 .github/scripts/generate-sbom.py \
  --source-root "$snapshot/sdd-forge-${TAG}" \
  --version="$TAG" \
  --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
  --output "sdd-forge-sbom.cdx.json"

steps.name: Publish SHA-256 checksums
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
sha256sum "$PKG" "sdd-forge-sbom.cdx.json" > SHA256SUMS
cat SHA256SUMS

files.contextual_review: Single45minute job with content/PR/issue writes required by its requested PR workflow; no OIDC. Secrets enter action/env inputs, not shell source. Pre-session ref fallback conservatively treats all PRs as new; the enforcement pipeline now uses pipefail. The no-CI labeling step is advisory. Completion validates exact run/attempt/head and integer-zero check values, emitting only fixed diagnostics. Recovery depends on whole-job success and explicit complete=true, after post actions; only issue-write permission remains in recovery.

steps.name: Enforce enforcement-chain guard on session PRs
steps.body:
set -euo pipefail
changed="$RUNNER_TEMP/session_changed_paths.txt"
pre_refs="$RUNNER_TEMP/pre_session_pr_refs.txt"
[ -f "$pre_refs" ] || : > "$pre_refs"
mapfile -t pre < "$pre_refs"
# ベースラインに無い head ref の open PR = セッションが作成した PR。
# その PR の変更ファイルパスだけを集約する(重複除去)。
gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 200 \
  --json headRefName,files \
  | jq -r '.[] | select(([.headRefName] | inside($ARGS.positional)) | not) | (.files // [])[].path' \
      --args "${pre[@]}" \
  | sort -u > "$changed"
echo "セッション作成 PR に紐づく変更パス:"
cat "$changed" || true
bash .github/scripts/self-improvement-pr-guard.sh "$changed"

steps.name: Label session PRs that triggered no CI
steps.body:
pre_refs="$RUNNER_TEMP/pre_session_pr_refs.txt"
[ -f "$pre_refs" ] || { echo "ベースライン無し: スキップ"; exit 0; }
mapfile -t pre < "$pre_refs"
session_prs="$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 200 \
  --json number,headRefName \
  | jq -r '.[] | select(([.headRefName] | inside($ARGS.positional)) | not) | .number' \
      --args "${pre[@]}")"
if [ -z "$session_prs" ]; then
  echo "セッション作成 PR なし"
  exit 0
fi
# (b) 経由なら CI トリガーまで数秒〜数十秒かかるため猶予を置く。
sleep 60
gh label create needs-ci --color D93F0B \
  --description "session-created PR with no CI runs; trigger CI before merging (issue #173)" \
  2>/dev/null || true
for n in $session_prs; do
  checks="$(gh pr view "$n" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --json statusCheckRollup --jq '.statusCheckRollup | length' || echo 0)"
  if [ "${checks:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then
    gh pr edit "$n" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --add-label needs-ci
    gh pr comment "$n" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
      --body "⚠ この PR には CI が 1 本も走っていません (issue #173)。SDD_SESSION_PR_TOKEN の登録/有効期限を確認し、空コミットの push などで test.yml をトリガーして required checks を green にしてからレビュー・マージしてください。"
    echo "PR #$n に needs-ci を付与"
  else
    echo "PR #$n: checks=$checks (CI トリガー済み)"
  fi
done

steps.name: Validate audit completion
steps.body:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess

def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError("duplicate completion field")
        result[key] = value
    return result

record = pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / (
    f'self-improvement-{os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"]}-{os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"]}.json'
)
try:
    data = json.loads(record.read_text(), object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
    reason = "unreadable" if isinstance(error, OSError) else "invalid_json"
    print("Audit completion diagnostic: " + json.dumps({"record": reason}), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit("Audit incomplete: completion evidence could not be read") from None
head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
checks = data.get("checks") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
valid = (
    isinstance(data, dict)
    and data.get("run_id") == os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"]
    and data.get("run_attempt") == os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"]
    and data.get("head") == head
    and data.get("status") == "complete"
    and isinstance(checks, dict)
    and set(checks) == {"guards", "install", "python", "node", "json_yaml"}
    and all(type(value) is int and value == 0 for value in checks.values())
)
if not valid:
    # Publish fixed categories only; record values and keys may contain secrets.
    fields = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    check_fields = checks if isinstance(checks, dict) else {}
    status = fields.get("status")
    diagnostic = {
        "record_object": isinstance(data, dict),
        "run_id_match": fields.get("run_id") == os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
        "run_attempt_match": fields.get("run_attempt") == os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"],
        "head_match": fields.get("head") == head,
        "status": status if status in ("complete", "partial") else "invalid",
        "check_names_match": isinstance(checks, dict) and set(checks) == {"guards", "install", "python", "node", "json_yaml"},
        "checks": {name: type(check_fields.get(name)) is int and check_fields[name] == 0
                   for name in ("guards", "install", "python", "node", "json_yaml")},
    }
    print("Audit completion diagnostic: " + json.dumps(diagnostic), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit("Audit incomplete: missing, stale or unsuccessful completion evidence")
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
    output.write("complete=true\n")
PY

steps.name: Report workflow failure as issue
steps.body:
if [ -n "$PREFLIGHT_REASON" ]; then
  reason="$PREFLIGHT_REASON"
elif [ "$CLAUDE_STEP_OUTCOME" = failure ]; then
  reason="Claude self-improvement action step failed. The issue report omits execution payload; inspect the action's sanitized run log."
elif [ "$COMPLETION_STEP_OUTCOME" = failure ]; then
  reason="Audit completion evidence is missing, partial, invalid or reports incomplete verification. The audit has not recovered; inspect the session report and completion-step log."
elif [ "$GUARD_STEP_OUTCOME" = failure ]; then
  reason="The enforcement-chain guard step failed. Inspect the run log for the guard's deterministic finding."
elif [ "$CI_SAFETY_STEP_OUTCOME" = failure ]; then
  reason="The session-PR CI safety-net step failed. Inspect the run log for the failing command."
else
  reason="A workflow step failed; inspect the run log for the failing step."
fi
run_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
body="$(printf -- '- 実行日時: %s\n- 推定原因: %s\n- 実行ログ: %s' \
  "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$reason" "$run_url")"
gh label create self-improvement --color 1D76DB \
  --description "weekly automated audit" 2>/dev/null || true
existing="$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open \
  --search '"Weekly self-improvement run failed" in:title' \
  --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')"
if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
  gh issue comment "$existing" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --body "$(printf -- '再失敗:\n%s' "$body")"
else
  gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --title "Weekly self-improvement run failed ($(date -u +%Y-%m-%d))" \
    --label self-improvement \
    --body "$body"
fi

steps.name: Close recovered workflow failure issue
steps.body:
[ "${AUDIT_COMPLETE:-}" = true ] || { echo "Audit completion not confirmed" >&2; exit 1; }
run_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
run_prefix="- 実行ログ: ${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/"
issue_number="$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 100 \
  --search '"Weekly self-improvement run failed" in:title' \
  --json number,title,body \
  | jq -r --arg prefix "$run_prefix" --arg current_run "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" '
      [ .[]
        | select(.title | test("^Weekly self-improvement run failed \\([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\\)$"))
        | select(
            [.body | split("\n")[]
              | select(startswith($prefix))
              | .[($prefix | length):]
              | select(test("^[0-9]+$"))
              | select(. != $current_run)] | length > 0)
      ]
      | sort_by(.number) | last | .number // empty')"
if [ -z "$issue_number" ]; then
  echo "No prior open failure-reporter issue with a repository Actions run link"
  exit 0
fi
gh issue comment "$issue_number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --body "この実行でワークフロー全体の成功を確認しました: ${run_url}"
gh issue close "$issue_number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"

files.contextual_review: Read-only CI spans PR, merge-group, main and manual triggers. Required-checks always runs and admits all17dependencies only in explicit success states, except advisory is allowed skipped iff trusted activation=false. All3MCP matrices and coding-standards are dependencies. Closed YAML matrix values and runner.temp are the only direct run interpolations besides enum job results and a trusted boolean output. Actual user/ref/sha data crosses env or checkout inputs. Bash tee pipelines have explicit bash (Actions -e -o pipefail); native PowerShell single-command steps propagate status. Two best-effort CLI installs do not establish live-host proof. A9 checks out PR code as data, executes trusted base collector, disables checkout credentials, uses private temp storage and uploads no raw advisory evidence.
